description: Review R2 and R6 (plan 261027): `ops` writes handoff/ops/<step-id>-generated.json, a name no hand-written ops/<STEP-ID>.json shares (even case-insensitively); the same plan again is unchanged and a changed plan is refused without replacing the file; it records each generated op's digest in sweep/ops-generated.json. memedit refuses an autonomous (no decision_id) insert into a MEMORY.md or a config-repo topic file when the digest is not recorded (a hand-written insert, a tampered generated file), and lets through the two hand-written autonomous inserts the sweep prose allows: an [improvement_signal] under ## Pattern of a project's MEMORY.md (review N1: not the config repo's MEMORY.md, not another section, and an autonomous replace keeps the prefix), and a node in HIGHER_ORDER.md. Review C5, C11, C14: an autonomous replace may not add the prefix either; a hand-written project signal carrying a human: actor is refused; an autonomous create of a topic file holds only a title and sections.
